notes.title: Sandra and Woo for Linux available now!
notes.notes:
Sandra and Woo in the Cursed Adventure for Linux is available now.

Thank you for your patience!

Note: Due to limitations of our engine version, multi-part Steam achievements are treated differently on Linux. Their Steam status bar won't get filled. Nevertheless, the achievement status will be counted by the game. This way also Linux players should be able to achieve all of them.

notes.title: Patch Notes May 11th, 2017
notes.notes:
(Version 1.1)

- Several bug fixes in the hacking minigame.
- Disabled the inventory in the poem minigame. It won't open anymore if the player types a word with the letter "i".
- Added two missing snoop effects (spacebar) to the main menu.

Thanks again to all bug reporters!

notes.title: Patch Notes May 8th, 2017
notes.notes:
The latest release includes the following bug fixes and enhancements.

- Correction of the way system in the tutorial.
- Correction of  Richards animation after finishing the costume.
- Correction of the version number in the English main menu.
- Correction of the street bug, putting a stone into the inventory.
- Added an English description for the postal package.
- Enhanced visibility of the action buttons on the phone.
- Correction of the ice cream bug, that prevented Larisa from eating it in the bathroom. 
- Correction of numerous typos. 

Thank you for your bug reports!
